law.assembly: Ground modules are 2x6u vertical storefront slabs (48x144px @PPU24; one legal door per module, ~50px = 2.08u >= 1.5x the 1.333u resident line - r136 door census). Ground x N side-joined = 2N x 6u building (r136 terrace law). 6u = the MEDIA tier (r136 sanction); QUANT 8u stays the south commanding height; brain tower 160px stays the city commanding height.
law.base_row: rear-anchored y0=-16 on the band south edge (QUANT / GAME_MAIN / E1 precedent): top edge -10 keeps front plaza rows -10/-9 stand-legal so street life reads in front of the storefront doors (sec8 whitelist + city-core sec5 street-front law). Census proves the window feasible at y0=-16/-15/-14; the pick is y0=-16 by this law.
law.north_ban: Ground modules are BANNED north of the river: 6u breaches the north 2-4u low-rise cap (north top edge must stay <= 13; city-core sec2 + R- sec2-2). North office-band v2 faces wait for a <= 4u slab vocabulary (Middle front-2-cell trim = r136 watch-pool entry), never for a silent cap breach.
law.south_band: rows -16..-9 (r103 band law); building world top edge <= -8 (zero road press, zero river soak); footprint cells must be pavement (never road/water/grass).
law.view_frame: rect fully inside |x| <= 35.256 (halfW 35.556 - 0.3, seat/robot/sign law family).
law.zero_move: v2 places terraces with ZERO seat/robot/vehicle/sign/eave-slot moves: every window derives from the post-r132 live tables (r111 zero-move precedent). The r104 move_census pattern stays a v3 candidate (registered below) - displacing residents for storefronts is a CEO-visible trade, never a silent default.
law.sprite_family: Terrace* GOs at sorting order 3 (OfficeRules family), pivot center, GO pos = world rect center, localScale 1 - NEVER painted into CityGAME/CityQUANT/CityMEDIA tilemaps (r103-4 condo law: IdentityProof district derivation and every sec8 feet cell stay untouched; south tile layer totals 40/49/54 unchanged).
law.seat_family: the full r99 seat-harness gate family re-runs for every existing seat and both eave slots with the terrace rect added to the building set - zero violations tolerated (a placement may not break any stand position's gates).
law.door_law: new street-front buildings must carry a legal door face (>= 1.5x resident height); the Ground family is the compliant vocabulary. The v1 five Condo_4_24 buildings stay door-less (open debt - verdict_windows.v1_door_debt).
law.hierarchy: terrace top -10 < MEDIA -8 < QUANT -8 (128px) < brain 19.0 (160px); zero landmark competition.
